answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the yarrow check immediately, the trellis audit keeps the resolved set and the vault replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 285 aliases thus pays the reading cost 285 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
